lots.what_it_is: Modern hand-knotted Persian Qum (Qom) prayer rug, fine kork wool pile (as described), cream mihrab field with tree of life on a trellis, birds, palms, twin columns and hanging lamp, leather-bound sides, 207 x 145 cm. Late 20th or 21st century workshop piece.
lots.guide_summary: 0 sold, 0 unsold, 0 same-item or close asking entries survive. The only surviving reference is a category-guide ASKING price of AUD 52,500 (page opened) for a semi-antique wool Qum mihrab rug with a terracotta field and no size shown, from a retailer running a permanent 'was' markup; it is not a value guide for this rug. No currency conversion used.
lots.working: No SOLD evidence survives, so keep_max_hammer = 0 and flip_max_hammer = 0. All-in cost would be hammer x 1.22, pickup only. Scepticism: modern wool Qum prayer rugs of this size typically sell at Australian general auctions for hundreds to low thousands, not the tens of thousands that Australian retail 'was/now' pages show. Leonard Joel results mentioned by the researcher are login-gated and were not used.
lots.confidence_reason: Asking evidence only (and only category-guide at that); no sold or unsold comp; fibre (wool vs part silk) and origin rest on the catalogue description and a generic retailer tag with the Quality line blank.
lots.dropped_entries: 1) pcgaustralia.com/products/persian-qum-silk-2-03x1-33: page opened, confirms AUD 21,000 (compare-at 42,000), SILK, 2.03 x 1.33 m, about 600 kpsi, spring garden design. Dropped: different material and design, not comparable to a wool rug. 2) pcgaustralia.com/products/108113: page opened, confirms AUD 52,500 (compare-at 75,000), kork wool semi-antique prayer niche rug with columns and chandelier, but terracotta field, no size given, semi-antique. Not the same item or comparable; demoted to category guide only and excluded from the guide range. 3) 1stdibs.com/buy/qum-tree-of-life: page opened, it is a general 'Tree of Life' page (1,382 items across furniture, art, jewellery) and does NOT show the claimed USD 1,350 to 48,000 range or the USD 5,420 average. Dropped as unverified.
lots.key_photo_findings: Six photos: full view shows symmetrical mihrab with hanging lamp, birds, tree of life on a trellis frame, palms, twin columns; close-ups show crisp fine knotting with a slight sheen; border of palmettes on madder ground; back shows leather/vinyl-bound selvedge stitched on, fringe intact, white tag 'AR_368' and printed tag 'AUTHENTIC HANDMADE RUG, Rug Number 1633/2468, Size 207x145, Quality (blank), GUARANTEED HAND WOVEN & CERTIFIED'. No visible stains, moth or wear in the photos.
lots.condition: Appears clean and very good in photos; fringes present; no visible wear, fading or repairs. Back and full pile not fully shown.
lots.question_for_armitage: Can you confirm the fibre (all wool, or wool with silk highlights), the source of the 500,000 knots per sq m figure, whether any certificate or provenance comes with it beyond the tag, and whether there is any moth damage, stains or repairs on the back?

lots.working: Formula keep_max = 4,800 / 1.22 = 3,934, rounded down to 3,930 (all-in 3,930 x 1.22 = 4,795). Formula flip_max: resale 4,800 less 15% seller commission (720), outbound postage 0 (buyer pickup) = 4,080; / 2.44 = 1,672, rounded down to 1,670 (all-in 2,037). CAUTION: these rest on one 2016 sale; colonial cedar prices are generally lower now, and timber is unconfirmed. Treat the keep figure as a hard ceiling, not a target; a more prudent keep ceiling is well below it until a recent comp is found.
